request: One-page pallet entry with three equal photo/order/customer columns, optional photo and plate, read-only review, floating warnings, stable customer search and minimum 15px text
acceptance: Desktop/tablet entry uses equal photo, order/scanner and customer columns; phone layout remains usable without horizontal overflow.
Customer search retains its input node, focus and caret; stale responses and errors cannot overwrite a newer query or follow navigation.
Phone search matches separators and optional +1 in the local directory and NetSuite fallback; code/name searches remain available.
Photos, plate and notes entered before selection survive customer/order lookup, review and back navigation. New Return clears them.
Pallet confirmation accepts absent photos and plate, posts one verified CM and remains idempotent. Invalid supplied photos, stock evidence and pallet quotas remain validated.
Review shows entered information without editable fields or camera controls; warnings use the Customer Pickup floating notice with Dismiss.
Pallet labels and numbers remain at least 15px, including when saved display preferences request smaller text.
CM location follows receiving yard: 3445/1, 2967/28, 150/26. NetSuite generates the number; customer messages retain actual CMB/CMA/CMM references.
validation: Existing bounded disposable runners; mocked providers and synthetic data only. Generated logs, screenshots and mutation copies are removed by the retention wrapper.
